workflow: Manually republishing dev.to articles to other platforms (Medium, personal blog, LinkedIn) one by one without any automation
current_workaround: Copy-paste article content, reformat Markdown, re-upload images, and adjust tags for each target platform
consequence: Time loss (30-60 minutes per article), risk of formatting errors, inconsistent cross-posting, article decay when updates are not reflected across platforms

workflow: Manually compiling cross-platform analytics from dev.to, Medium, and personal blog into a single spreadsheet for reporting
trigger: Weekly or monthly performance reporting requirement
current_workaround: Export CSV from dev.to stats, copy data from other platforms, then manually reconcile in Excel
consequence: Hours spent every week, data entry errors, no real-time view of content performance

workflow: Manually reviewing and approving or deleting comments on popular articles to filter spam and abusive content
current_workaround: Reading every comment, clicking to approve/reject in dev.to dashboard, no bulk moderation or keyword filtering
consequence: Moderation fatigue, delayed response, spam may appear before removal, community trust erodes

workflow: Manually invoking the dev.to API to publish articles from a CI/CD pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions) because there is no native integration
trigger: Every time a new draft is ready in a GitHub repo
current_workaround: Writing custom scripts using fetch/curl, managing API tokens, handling errors, and manually triggering the action
consequence: Fragile custom scripts, maintenance burden, risk of API rate limits, no automatic retry or error handling

workflow: Manually switching between multiple dev.to accounts (personal and organization) to manage posts and comments
trigger: Need to act on behalf of an organization or manage multiple author profiles
current_workaround: Logging out and logging in with different credentials, or using browser profiles
consequence: Time wasted, accidental posting under wrong account, inability to schedule cross-account actions
